Booking engine for hotels and tours

Guests book and pay directly on your website, so less commission goes to aggregators. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 108 mln; the full version in 14–22 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Availability calendar
  • Rates and seasons
  • Booking with prepayment (Click, Payme, Visa/Mastercard)
  • Confirmations by email and Telegram
  • Admin for rooms or tours
What the full version adds
  • Channel sync with Booking.com and others
  • Promo codes
  • Several currencies
  • Extras such as transfers and excursions
  • Reviews
  • Reports

  • Domain and hosting access
  • Texts, photos and the logo
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions

What does “Booking engine for hotels and tours” cost?
The MVP costs $9,000–18,000 (UZS 108–220 mln), the full version $22,000–50,000 (UZS 260–605 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Booking engine for hotels and tours” take?
The MVP takes 6–10 weeks, the full version 14–22 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Domain and hosting access; texts, photos and the logo; one person who makes the decisions.
